# Taxonomy

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A hierarchical classification scheme that organizes concepts into broader/narrower relationships.

## Scope note

Refers to the SKOS concept scheme built in the SKOS Editor - the structural layer between the flat Glossary stage and the formal Ontology stage.
